summary: First e2e test of Expo Proxy MVP. All 16 backend pytest cases pass and all 4 frontend sections (Overview, Content Director, AdSmith, EchoLink) render + interact correctly. AdSmith closed loop verified — reconcile appends a new week and shifts budget toward the ROAS winner (bounded 0.2–0.8). Critic grades match spec (video 0=STRONG, video 1=WEAK). Spin skew for new vs repeat guests verified statistically. Transcript cleaner removes fillers and collapses duplicates. Sidebar navigation between all 4 sections works with no console errors.

issues: Because the seeded loop already lands at 0.8/0.2 (max share) by week 5, clicking 'Run Next Week' the first time does not visibly move the share bars — only revenue/ROAS numbers update. This is correct-by-spec (bounded 0.2–0.8) but demo-wise it can look like nothing happened. Consider starting the seeded history at 3 weeks (still short of 0.8 cap) so the first live reconcile visibly shifts the chart.

action_items: Optional demo polish: seed AdSmith with 3 weeks of history instead of 5 so the first 'Run Next Week' click produces a visible share shift on the chart (currently share is already pinned at the 0.8 cap by week 5, which is spec-correct but visually flat).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 262: `base = _round((dollars // c) if False else round(dollars / c, 2))` — the `if False` branch is dead code; simplify to `base = round(dollars / c, 2)`.

api.js `spin(isNewGuest)` never forwards a `segment` — the backend has segment-aware odds (promo_pool 5%, vip 80%, else 10%) but the UI can't exercise the promo_pool or vip explicit paths. Fine for MVP; consider exposing segment toggles later.
echolink/spin uses `random.Random()` with no seed (non-deterministic). The rest of the demo is deterministic — consider seeding or documenting that spin is intentionally random for the gamified feel.
Frontend `App.js`: mobile nav uses `mnav-*` testids but sidebar uses `nav-*`. Fine, but keep both aligned in docs so testers know which to target per viewport.
test_credentials: None — no auth in this app (all external systems mocked by design).
seed_data_creation: None. Backend seeds itself deterministically (5 weeks of reports, 15 RFMD customers, 30-day drip). Tests call POST /api/adsmith/reset before mutating tests to ensure known state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 16 tests, all pass). Reset endpoint (POST /api/adsmith/reset) restores the 5-week REPORTS store — call it before any test that reads the reports list, since /api/adsmith/reconcile mutates in-memory state. Public URL for testing: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. All 4 nav sections use data-testids `nav-overview|content|adsmith|echolink`.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Everything works as designed for the MVP scope.
